There is no reason to leave this off.","Automated emails are complementary, not a replacement — Smart Retries recovers silently; emails prompt customer action (update card, authenticate). Use both together.","Automatic card updates are free and passive — Stripe updates saved card numbers when networks issue replacements. No config needed beyond enabling it.","Custom Automations layer on top of Smart Retries — they don't replace retries; they add business-specific logic like escalation paths, team notifications, or segment-specific email cadences.","The decision of what happens after all retries fail (cancel, mark unpaid, or leave past_due) is a configuration detail — set in Dashboard under Billing \u003E Revenue Recovery settings."],"title":"Revenue Recovery","questions":[{"prompt":"Do you want Stripe to automatically handle failed payment recovery?","id":"subs_recovery_auto","options":[{"notes":[],"next_question_id":"subs_recovery_custom_logic","id":"yes_subs_recovery_auto","label":"YES"},{"notes":["Listen to invoice.payment_failed events and trigger your own dunning logic in your existing systems."],"doc_links":[{"url":"https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks","label":"Manual Recovery via Webhooks"}],"id":"no_subs_recovery_auto","accept_attributes":{},"label":"NO (handle recovery manually)"}]},{"prompt":"Do you need custom recovery logic beyond Stripe's defaults?","id":"subs_recovery_custom_logic","options":[{"notes":["Stripe's ML-powered retry system + failed payment emails + automatic card updates. Tax calculation activates at checkout in locations where you have a registration.","Free threshold monitoring is the right starting point for businesses with no current tax obligations — there is no tax collection, no code integration, and no ongoing configuration required beyond the product tax category. Stripe monitors your global sales exposure and alerts when you reach a threshold in a new location.","Stripe Tax supports VAT, GST, sales tax, QST, and more across 100+ countries — the product tax category determines the correct rate for each jurisdiction."],"title":"Decision Tree #7: How to Handle Tax Compliance","questions":[{"prompt":"Did you choose an option in Decision Tree 1 that enabled Managed Payments?","id":"tax_managed_payments","options":[{"notes":[],"next_question_id":"tax_has_obligations","id":"no_managed_payments","label":"No — not using Managed Payments"}]},{"prompt":"Are you collecting sales tax, VAT, or GST in any locations today?","id":"tax_has_obligations","options":[{"notes":["Configure your Stripe Tax settings and add registrations to start collecting tax.","With Stripe Tax you can automatically manage your registrations, calculate and collect the right amount of tax worldwide, and file returns — all in one place."],"doc_links":[{"url":"https://docs.stripe.com/tax","label":"Stripe Tax"}],"id":"yes_tax_obligations","accept_attributes":{},"label":"Yes — Stripe Tax w/ collection ⭐ (DEFAULT)"},{"notes":["Assign a product tax category and confirm your head office address.","Stripe Tax tracks your sales against global tax thresholds for free and alerts you before you cross into taxable territory.","No tax collection, no code integration, and no ongoing configuration required beyond the product tax category."],"doc_links":[{"url":"https://docs.stripe.com/tax/monitoring","label":"Stripe Tax threshold monitoring"}],"id":"no_tax_obligations","accept_attributes":{},"label":"No — no current tax obligations → Free Threshold Monitoring"}]}],"use_case_key":"optimize_subscriptions"}],"status":"draft","use_cases":[{"title":"Optimize subscriptions","key":"optimize_subscriptions","summary":"Recurring or hybrid usage businesses that need a stronger subscription loop."}],"guide_id":"iguide_61VeiPSXAkTnAUxwE41Jc495o6GfK"}
